boss-pig-reference.referenceDescription: User's actual upright pale pink velour pig plush photographed tipped back in a chair. Toy only; background and accessories removed.
boss-pig-reference.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent photographic boss sprite cutout for a detailed 2D side-scrolling game. Input image 1 is the user's actual pink pig plush toy reference; preserve THIS toy's material, proportions, identity and sewn construction. Primary request: isolate and re-pose this exact giant pale pink velour stuffed pig, now standing upright on its TWO short soft legs for combat. It has an oversized roughly spherical head, a large protruding broad rounded oval/cylindrical darker-pink snout with embroidered pink nostrils, an elongated round pear-shaped giant belly, two small dangling stuffed arms, two stubby soft dangling legs/feet, small floppy ears, subtle existing eye embroidery, visible sewn panels and natural velour wrinkles. Retain the reference's pale pink body and slightly darker rosy snout and extremity tips. Do not replace it with a generic fuzzy farm pig, do not give it four walking legs, and do not give it a costume. Orientation: LEFT-facing side profile or slight three-quarter SIDE view, snout clearly projecting LEFT, one understated eye if visible; the upright silhouette should be tall and broad with width about 0.7-0.8 times height including its snout. Both small arms and both stubby feet remain readable, soft feet rest at same bottom baseline, no biped human musculature. Full entire head, ears, snout, arms, belly and feet in frame, centered on vertical canvas with transparent margin around all edges. Medium: detailed photographic plush-toy cutout with accurate short velour pile rather than long fuzzy fur; softly warm upper-left lighting and gentle shaded volume. Remove ALL background and accessories: no chair, wall, floor, bag, purple tube, purple/blue ball, cord or any other object. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, opaque plush only, no ground/cast shadow, no glow or halo. No labels, text, logos, watermark, UI, human face, hero face reference, extra person or extra pig. Preserve this reference toy's identifying head, snout, body shape and fabric instead of previous invented pig designs.

wood-surface.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: opaque seamless square material texture tile for crate, shelf, and counter surfaces in a detailed 2D game. Primary request: a face-on photograph of a continuous warm worn oak/walnut wooden surface, medium warm brown with mellow golden highlights, restrained fine horizontal wood grain, small subtle natural variations and light rubbed wear, believable satin wood finish. Composition: perfectly flat front-on texture with no perspective, square canvas entirely filled edge to edge by the wooden material. Style: photographic material/albedo quality. Lighting: soft nearly uniform diffuse illumination, mild warm directional influence, no strong gradient or hotspot. The left/right edges and top/bottom edges should match for seamless repeating tiling; keep texture low contrast and visually subtle so game silhouettes remain readable. Constraints: no objects, planks or visible board borders, no knots larger than fine grain, no hardware, no nails, no shapes, no scenery, no cast shadow, no text/logos/numbers/frame/watermark/UI; no perspective or dramatic shading, no illustration, no noisy damage pattern. Opaque background.

steel-surface.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: opaque seamless square material texture tile for stainless-steel game prop surfaces. Composition: square canvas filled entirely edge to edge with the metal material, flat orthographic surface with no perspective and no recognizable object. Style: photographic material/albedo quality. The left/right edges and top/bottom edges should match for seamless tiling; low contrast, clean and subtle, suitable for repeating within procedural game geometry at small scale. Constraints: no objects, tools, rivets, seams or borders, no fingerprints, no rust, no heavy damage, no scenery or reflections of identifiable objects, no cast shadow, no text/logos/numbers/frame/watermark/UI, no perspective, no illustration. Opaque background.
